rationale: Robert brings production ML infrastructure experience as CTO at Capes, while Karen is actively researching mechanistic interpretability and building AI tooling—two complementary angles on making ML systems more robust and understandable. Both work extensively in Python and share interests spanning ML research and infrastructure, making this a natural fit for knowledge exchange on how production systems and research insights can inform each other.
intro_message: Robert Amanfu, meet Karen Mkrtchyan — Robert's ML infrastructure work at Capes and Karen's mechanistic interpretability research could spark interesting conversations about bridging production ML and interpretability research.
